objective: Reduce repeated-symbol concentration without throwing away the underlying Consensus opportunity set.
cooldown_definition: Trading-day index difference. Same symbol is blocked while current_day_index - last_selected_day_index < cooldown_days; same-day reselection is blocked for cooldown>0.
replacement_rule: For each date/session in chronological order, choose the highest cons_min candidate not blocked by cooldown. If all Top-K candidates are blocked, emit NO TRADE.
entry_return: D+1 daily open -> D+5 daily close

selection_rule.diversification_requirement: max-symbol share reduced by at least 25% relative to cooldown0
selection_rule.chooser: among eligible policies choose higher Top3-excluded mean; tie -> lower max-symbol share
